title: Hari 27: Divisyen 5
notes: Source of truth for Episode 2 TTS and timed subtitles. Casual spoken Malay only. No CTAs. Ends on a dramatic line then a hard cut to the black BULOH FC / EPISOD 2 title card.

scenes.name: Opening Hook — Dark Office / Default Notice
scenes.visual: Smooth eased push-in on the DEFAULT NOTICE folder on a dark desk.
scenes.sfx: Heavy stamp/thud on DEFAULT NOTICE at 0.0s.
scenes.bgm: Tense, low-energy melancholic underscore, ducked under voiceover.

lines.text: Hutang empat ratus lima puluh ribu ringgit. Masa makin suntuk.

scenes.name: Rejected Sponsor — Beat 1: Nexus Sports
scenes.visual: Cool blue lighting. Executive shakes head on Y axis and waves hand dismissively. Clean hands/laptop, no stiff A-pose.
scenes.sfx: Subtle desk tap on the head shake.
scenes.bgm: Tense underscore continues, ducked under dialogue.

lines.text: Satu demi satu penaja besar dia ketuk... tapi semua tutup pintu.

lines.speaker: PENAJA 1
lines.text: Divisyen lima? Maaf lah bro, memang tak berbaloi.

scenes.name: Rejected Sponsor — Beat 2: Apex Corp
scenes.visual: Distinct executive (receding hair, grey hair color, charcoal/burgundy suit). Slides the proposal folder back across the desk. NO clones.

lines.speaker: PENAJA 2
lines.text: Kalau kelab besar, boleh la cerita. Ini risiko tinggi sangat.

scenes.name: Rejected Sponsor — Beat 3: Closing Door
scenes.visual: PEMILIK stands outside with slumped shoulders as an office door swings shut in front of the camera, cutting briefly to black.
scenes.bgm: Underscore dips to near silence on the slam.

lines.text: Semua pintu tertutup. Tinggal harapan kosong je.

scenes.name: Kek Maju Bakery — Warm Contrast
scenes.environment: BakeryApp (dedicated bakery: front counter, glass cake display, wall-mounted KEK MAJU sign, warm lighting)
scenes.visual: Female bakery owner in an apron, warm gesturing/nodding, handing over a small envelope. Distinct from the club office; no outdoor signpost indoors.
scenes.sfx: Warm shop bell chime on entry.
scenes.bgm: Crossfade to warm, hopeful acoustic underscore.

lines.text: Sampai la dia singgah kat satu kedai kek kecil ni... Kek Maju.

lines.speaker: KEK MAJU
lines.text: Akak bukan orang kaya, tapi akak sayang kelab kita ni. Ambik la sikit ni, buat modal dulu.

lines.speaker: PEMILIK
lines.text: Terima kasih banyak, kak. Kami memang takkan lupa jasa akak.

scenes.name: Buloh FC Office & Dramatic Ending
scenes.environment: ManagerOfficeApp (wall-mounted PERLAWANAN AMAL whiteboard/poster, no signpost)
scenes.visual: PEMILIK and JURULATIH face each other, subtle talking/nodding, ending on a slow dramatic push-in on PEMILIK.
scenes.sfx: Room tone only; no sting on the final line.
scenes.bgm: Warm underscore returns, then thins out for the final line.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Kalau macam tu, kita buat perlawanan amal. Biar satu pekan tahu Buloh FC belum mati.

lines.speaker: PEMILIK
lines.text: Betul. Ini peluang terakhir kita. Kalau kalah, semua habis.

scenes.name: Outro Title Card
scenes.visual: Hard cut to clean black card: BULOH FC / thin gold divider / EPISOD 2. No CTA.
